description: In-world displays (desk monitors + Task Wall + task detail screen) on the showcase state. Cameras come from the HQ builder's anchors (dev.anchors). The desk close-ups nudge cam_desk_<id> with world offsets tuned for the test room (desks facing south) so the agent and its nameplate do not hide the monitor; with the real HQ, re-tune the offsets (or give the shots their own anchors). Run: node tools/shoot.mjs tools/scenes/displays.json --port <devPort> --foreman <foremanPort> --prefix displays/
